title: RegimeTrader
oneLiner: A regime-aware Nifty 50 predictor on a SQLite star schema, built to report its own failures.
claim: Locks the test period before running it, then reports that the strategy has no reliable edge.

metrics: 144,105 daily OHLCV rows over 2,910 trading dates in a star-schema warehouse
Frozen test period of 685 trading days guarded by a one-time run lock and config hashes
Classifier ROC-AUC between 0.5140 and 0.5201 across 34,200 test stock-days - barely above a coin flip
Sharpe 0.4848 with a 95% block-bootstrap CI of [-0.4561, 1.5437], so the edge is not distinguishable from zero

proof.architecture: Everything lands in one relational warehouse with foreign keys on: raw bars, indicators, regimes, model probabilities, trades and daily marks. Preprocessors and the unsupervised regime model are fitted only on data up to 2022-12-31 and frozen. Classifiers retrain annually on an expanding window with a five-day embargo. Backtest and paper-trading call the same signal-to-weight code, so the two cannot disagree.
